title: Turnover, Training, and Time — The Three Costs Companies Underestimate
content:
###  **Cost One — Turnover** 

Field roles see high turnover. Every departure means starting the hiring and training cycle over, often more than once in a single season. 

###  **Cost Two — Training** 

Effective field representation is a skill, not an instinct. Teaching it takes real time, and that investment is made whether or not the new hire stays long enough to make it worthwhile. 

###  **Cost Three — Time** 

Perhaps the most underestimated cost of all: the owner or manager's own time spent recruiting, training, and supervising — time not spent running or growing the business itself. 

###  **Why These Three Compound** 

Individually, each cost seems manageable. Together, across a full season of hiring and re-hiring, they often add up to more than most companies expect when they first decide to build a team. 

###  **A Simpler Comparison** 

A structured pilot sidesteps all three of these costs — worth comparing before committing to building independently.
